name: 48125 · Dearborn Hts, MI
findings: ZIP 48125 (Dearborn Hts) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48125 (Dearborn Hts) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48125 (Dearborn Hts) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
